From f8ada189550984ee21f27be736042b74a7da1d68 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Xu YiPing <xuyiping@hisilicon.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2017 15:39:26 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] arm64: perf: remove unsupported events for Cortex-A73

bus access read/write events are not supported in A73, based on the
Cortex-A73 TRM r0p2, section 11.9 Events (pages 11-457 to 11-460).

Fixes: 5561b6c5e981 "arm64: perf: add support for Cortex-A73"
Acked-by: Julien Thierry <julien.thierry@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Xu YiPing <xuyiping@hisilicon.com>
Signed-off-by: Will Deacon <will.deacon@arm.com>

diff --git a/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c b/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c
index 9eaef51f83ff..3affca3dd96a 100644
--- a/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c
+++ b/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c
@@ -262,12 +262,6 @@ static const unsigned armv8_a73_perf_cache_map[PERF_COUNT_HW_CACHE_MAX]
 
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_RD,
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
 };
 
 static const unsigned armv8_thunder_perf_cache_map[PERF_COUNT_HW_CACHE_MAX]
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c`**
- Removed the following lines related to bus access read/write events for Cortex-A73:
  ```c
  [C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
  [C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
  ```
- The lines were removed because bus access events are not supported in the Cortex-A73 architecture, as specified in the Cortex-A73 Technical Reference Manual (TRM).

### Relationships
- The modifications are directly related to the previously added support for Cortex-A73 performance events, as indicated by the fix reference to commit `5561b6c5e981`. The removal of unsupported bus access events corrects the earlier implementation, ensuring that the performance monitoring features accurately reflect the capabilities of the Cortex-A73 processor.

Here is the commit message:
arm64: perf: remove unsupported events for Cortex-A73

bus access read/write events are not supported in A73, based on the
Cortex-A73 TRM r0p2, section 11.9 Events (pages 11-457 to 11-460).

Fixes: 5561b6c5e981 "arm64: perf: add support for Cortex-A73"
Acked-by: Julien Thierry <julien.thierry@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Xu YiPing <xuyiping@hisilicon.com>
Signed-off-by: Will Deacon <will.deacon@arm.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the inclusion of unsupported bus access read/write events in the performance event mapping for the Cortex-A73 architecture, which do not exist according to the Cortex-A73 Technical Reference Manual (TRM). This led to incorrect performance monitoring capabilities being reported for the processor.

Here is the patch:
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_RD,
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
 };

```c

[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
```
Reason:
These statements incorrectly map unsupported bus access read/write events to the performance event configuration for the Cortex-A73 architecture, which does not support these events according to the Cortex-A73 Technical Reference Manual (TRM). This results in the processor reporting incorrect performance monitoring capabilities.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
```
Reason:
The removal of these statements eliminates the mapping of unsupported bus access events, ensuring that the performance event configuration accurately reflects the capabilities of the Cortex-A73 architecture as specified in the TRM. This prevents incorrect performance monitoring capabilities from being reported.
